identity.title: Any-Order GPT as Masked Diffusion Model: Decoupling Formulation and Architecture

problem.claim: The paper investigates masked diffusion models within a decoder-only framework to compare them with standard autoregressive models and examine architectural effects on computational efficiency.

gap.claim: Comparisons between autoregressive and masked diffusion paradigms are confounded by their typically different architectures, obscuring algorithmic and efficiency trade-offs.

contributions.claim: A decoder-only formulation of masked diffusion models, framed as Any-Order autoregression, for disentangling modeling formulation from architecture.
An investigation of how masked-diffusion architectural choices affect computational efficiency.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors distinguish core modeling choices from architectural influences by evaluating masked diffusion models in a decoder-only framework.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that decoder-only masked diffusion models can achieve approximately 25× inference speedups and comparable perplexity, using techniques such as temperature annealing.

narrative_sequence.summary: Scaling language models motivates alternatives to dominant autoregressive methods, including masked diffusion models.
Existing comparisons are confounded because autoregressive and masked diffusion models commonly use different architectures.
The work places masked diffusion modeling in a decoder-only framework to enable equitable comparison and isolate architectural effects on efficiency.
The authors report substantial inference speedups with comparable perplexity and position the framework as a route toward lower inference compute.

source_observation.claim: The abstract explicitly separates modeling formulation from architecture and evaluates both within a common decoder-only framework before comparing trade-offs.

lessons.interpretation: A shared architectural setting can make comparisons more diagnostic by reducing a major source of confounding.
lessons.application: When comparing sequence-modeling paradigms, hold the architecture fixed where feasible and state which factor each experiment is intended to isolate.
lessons.exception: This move may be unsuitable when the architecture is intrinsic to the paradigm or when deployment requires comparing complete end-to-end systems.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the benchmarks, model scales, inference settings, or baseline details supporting the approximately 25× speedup and comparable perplexity.
The scope and conditions under which temperature annealing yields the reported outcome are unspecified.
